summary: Pass. At 14 acres the lot cannot fit 100 MW, and Los Angeles adds expensive power, a four-year grid queue and extreme water stress.

sections.finding: 14 acres in an industrial zone; at least 40 acres is needed for 100 MW with cooling yards.
Nearest substation is 2.1 mi away and would likely need an upgrade.
Extremely high baseline water stress; evaporative cooling would face restrictions.
Two regional data center projects were delayed by local opposition since 2024.
